```python
import re

def is_valid_email(email: str) -> bool:
    pattern = r"^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$"
    return bool(re.match(pattern, email))
```

It checks for the basic shape: some text, an `@`, a domain, then a dot and a letters-only ending. Good enough for form checks, but not a full mail-standard checker — for that, the real test is sending a confirmation email.
